verdict.rationale: Auth0 has explicit first-party documentation of the Client Credentials Flow specifically designed for M2M applications (CLIs, daemons, backend services) authenticating without a human user, and this is directly reinforced by the AI-specific agent-auth docs describing unique agent identities and secure API access. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification/benchmarks of the client-credentials flow specifically in agent contexts (community evidence is largely about general auth experience, not this specific flow).
